raw_text: Wagner units have taken full control of Rostov military district headquarters. General Yunus-Bek Yevkurov seen negotiating with Prigozhin inside the command center. Anti-aircraft systems deployed around key positions. Local police have been ordered to stand down. Wagner fighters distributing water to civilians near the HQ.
